declaration_verdict.note: stated in part or not at all (DELTA); relation partial; the auditor's reading: From an AxisFunction's smoothness, slicewise holomorphy and evenness, every mixed jet ∂_X^k ∂_η^m of its pullback is holomorphic in the parameter on the same open set. Instantiated at base … 4 this gives the 'same parameter neighborhood at every fixed radial derivative' half of clause (ii) for V_0/X

theorem mixedAxisJet_pullback_holomorphic_full {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) {U : Set ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) {F : ℝ × ℂ → B} (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Ioo (-R) R ×ˢ U))
    (hhol : ∀ r ∈ Ioo (-R) R, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => F (r, z)) U)
    (he : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ r ∈ Ioo (-R) R, F (-r, z) = F (r, z)) (k m : ℕ)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (-R) R) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => mixedAxisJet F k m (r ^ 2, z)) U
